"""One bounded zero-native-call assessment of the immutable Panel 1 evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,math,statistics,sys,tempfile
import numpy as np
import ownership_cells as oc
import qualify as q
import routing
root=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); manifest=root/'panel1-plan.json'
plan=q.read(manifest); oc.verify_files(plan,manifest)
scored=q.read(root/'panel1/results.json'); diag=q.read(root/'panel1-diagnostic/results.json')
report=oc.report(manifest,root/'panel1',root/'panel1-report.json',accounting=root/'panel1-accounting.txt')
assert diag['status']=='complete' and diag['diagnostic'] and not diag['failures'] and diag['retries']==0 and not diag['exclusions']
assert diag['native_calls_started']==len(plan['diagnostic_schedule'])==96 and diag['elapsed_s']<600
assert diag['scored_result_sha256']==q.digest(root/'panel1/results.json')
assert diag['manifest_sha256']==scored['manifest_sha256'] and diag['host']['isolation_ok'] and not diag['host']['errors']
q.accounting((root/'panel1-accounting.txt').read_text(),diag['host']['host'],normalize=True)
assert q.digest(root/'panel1-diagnostic/host/host-observations.jsonl')==diag['host_observations_sha256']
assert [{k:c[k] for k in ('cell','arm','phase','block','mirror')} for c in diag['calls']]==plan['diagnostic_schedule']
warm={(c['cell'],c['arm']):c for c in scored['calls'] if c['phase']=='warmup'}
for call in diag['calls']:
    assert call['status']=='passed' and call['oracle']=='passed'
    target=root/'panel1-diagnostic'/call['target']; log=root/'panel1-diagnostic'/call['log']
    assert q.digest(target)==call['result_sha256'] and q.digest(log)==call['log_sha256']
    raw=q.read(target); assert raw.pop('columns')==[] and raw==call['raw_result']
    timer=oc.re.findall(r'^NATIVE_SECONDS=([0-9.]+)$',log.read_text(),oc.re.M)
    assert len(timer)==1 and float(timer[0])==call['seconds'] and 0<call['seconds']<=120
    assert call['fingerprint']==routing.identity({**q.exact_view(raw,False),'columns_sha256':call['columns_sha256']})
    prior=warm[call['cell'],call['arm']]
    for value,trace_log in [(call,log),(prior,root/'panel1'/prior['log'])]:
        assert value['solver_trace_lines']==[line for line in trace_log.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE|')]
    assert call['fingerprint']==prior['fingerprint'] and call['worker_signature']==prior['worker_signature']
    assert oc.hierarchies(call)==oc.hierarchies(prior),'diagnostic hierarchy differs from scored warmup'
    assert call['route_trace']==prior['route_trace'] and call['route_hierarchy']==prior['route_hierarchy']
    # Available-memory admission limits are observations, not solver decisions;
    # resource_diagnostics independently validates each original used/limit pair.
    def actions(value):
        return [{k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!='memory_bytes_limit'} for a in value['action_resources']]
    assert actions(call)==actions(prior),'diagnostic action semantics differ from scored warmup'
    def decisions(value):
        phases={'two_fe_gates','remaining_checkpoint','auto_direct_route','auto_direct_certified','auto_kernel_route'}
        records=[dict(part.split('=',1) for part in line.split('|')[1:] if '=' in part) for line in value['solver_trace_lines']]
        return [record for record in records if record.get('phase') in phases]
    assert decisions(call)==decisions(prior),'diagnostic gate/direct decisions differ from scored warmup'
    assert call['ownership_diagnostic']==oc.ownership_diagnostic(log.read_text(),plan['arms'][call['arm']])
    resource=q.science.resource_diagnostics(log.read_text(),None,False,{})
    assert all(call[k]==v for k,v in resource.items())
# Reconstruct every full-column warmup/diagnostic fingerprint from frozen input
# bits and retained output arrays, and recheck the independent mathematics.
checked=[]
for item in plan['cases']:
    source=q.resolve(manifest,item['input']);meta=q.metadata(plan,item,manifest)
    with source.open('rb') as stream:
        shape,_=q.case_header(stream); rows,width=shape[:2]; base=np.empty((width,rows),dtype=np.uint64)
        for j in range(width):
            assert stream.readline()==b'0\n'
            text=stream.read(rows*17);assert len(text)==rows*17 and all(text[i]==10 for i in range(16,len(text),17))
            base[j]=np.frombuffer(bytes.fromhex(text.decode('ascii')),dtype='>u8').astype(np.uint64)
    for label,result in [('panel1',scored),('panel1-diagnostic',diag)]:
        for workers in (1,4):
            cell=f"{item['id']}-t{workers}"
            for arm in oc.physical_arms(plan):
                ref=result['cells'][cell]['references'][arm]; path=root/label/ref['path']
                assert q.digest(path.with_suffix('.json'))==ref['head'] and q.digest(path.with_suffix('.npz'))==ref['outputs']
                data=base.copy()
                with np.load(path.with_suffix('.npz'),allow_pickle=False) as arrays:
                    assert set(arrays.files)=={str(i) for i in set(meta['outputs'].values())|set(meta.get('saved',[]))}
                    for key in arrays.files:
                        assert arrays[key].dtype==np.uint64 and arrays[key].shape==(rows,)
                        data[int(key)]=arrays[key]
                digest=hashlib.sha256(data.tobytes(order='C')).hexdigest(); raw=q.read(path.with_suffix('.json'))
                fingerprint=routing.identity({**q.exact_view(raw,False),'columns_sha256':digest})
                assert fingerprint==result['cells'][cell]['fingerprints'][arm]
                with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=root,suffix='.columns') as temp:
                    data.tofile(temp);temp.flush();q.science.check_oracle(raw,Path(temp.name),meta)
                checked.append(dict(cohort=label,cell=cell,arm=arm,columns_sha256=digest,fingerprint=fingerprint,oracle='passed'))
# Independently derive the paired summaries, without calling the report reducer.
index={(c['cell'],c['arm'],c['block'],c['mirror']):c['seconds'] for c in scored['calls'] if c['phase']=='scored'}
assert len(index)==1152
for row in report['comparisons']:
    differences=[]; ratios=[]; excess=[]
    for block in range(6):
        b=(index[row['cell'],'B',block,0]+index[row['cell'],'B',block,1])/2
        alias=plan['aliases'][row['arm']]
        c=(index[row['cell'],alias,block,0]+index[row['cell'],alias,block,1])/2
        differences.append(c-b);ratios.append(c/b);excess.append(c-b-max(.05*b,.001))
    for name,values in [('mean_difference_s',differences),('mean_ratio',ratios),('mean_excess_s',excess)]:
        assert math.isclose(row[name],sum(values)/6,rel_tol=1e-13,abs_tol=1e-15)
for arm,value in report['equal_weight_mean_difference_s'].items():
    rows=[r['mean_difference_s'] for r in report['comparisons'] if r['arm']==arm]
    assert len(rows)==24 and math.isclose(value,sum(rows)/24,rel_tol=1e-13,abs_tol=1e-15)
oc.verify_files(plan,manifest)
oc.save_new(root/'panel1-assessment.json',dict(schema=1,status='verified',native_calls=0,scored_calls=1248,diagnostic_calls=96,reconstructed_references=checked,paired_comparisons=72,diagnostic_route_hierarchy_matches_scored=True,source_verified_before_after=True,report_sha256=q.digest(root/'panel1-report.json'),limitations=['Development point estimates from one host; no activation qualification.','Phase timings include overlapping preparation and do not identify isolated causal kernel costs.']))
print('OWNERSHIP_PANEL1_ASSESSMENT_COMPLETE')
